name: [PILOT] Gemini Meeting Notes Intake (Gmail → Cursor review card)

nodes.name: Gemini Notes Gmail Trigger
nodes.notes: Bind a service mailbox credential. This is only a cheap first-pass filter; the calendar series allowlist is authoritative.

nodes.name: Get Full Gemini Email
nodes.notes: Bind the same Gmail OAuth credential. The email supplies the Doc URL; the Doc remains the notes source.

nodes.name: Apply Meeting Identity and Idempotency Gate
nodes.notes: Prototype/variable-free identity gate. Gmail subject and Doc ID are the source-of-truth inputs; Calendar is intentionally not required in this flow.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ { repo: 'ElishaSamPeterPrabhu/modus-wc-2.0', branch: 'main', docId: $('Apply Meeting Identity and Idempotency Gate').item.json.docId, docUrl: $('Apply Meeting Identity and Idempotency Gate').item.json.docUrl, meetingType: $('Apply Meeting Identity and Idempotency Gate').item.json.title, meetingDate: $('Apply Meeting Identity and Idempotency Gate').item.json.meetingDate, reviewId: `meeting-${$('Apply Meeting Identity and Idempotency Gate').item.json.docId}-${Date.now()}`, reviewReadyCallbackUrl: 'https://flows-webhook.stage.trimble-ai.com/agentic/workflows/v1/webhook/pilot-meeting-review-ready', reviewDelivery: 'n8n-callback', source: 'Gemini meeting notes' } }}

nodes.name: Call Cursor Meeting Intake
nodes.notes: Cursor reads the Google Doc and private repository, then POSTs {reviewId, items, chatResponse} to reviewReadyCallbackUrl. The callback workflow persists state and owns Chat delivery. Cursor needs CURSOR_REVIEW_CALLBACK_TOKEN as a runtime secret.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ { repo: 'ElishaSamPeterPrabhu/modus-wc-2.0', title: $json.item.rawText, summary: $json.item.sourceExcerpt, type: $json.item.classification === 'design-work' ? 'design' : 'feature', components: $json.item.componentHints || [], labels: $json.item.classification === 'design-work' ? ['needs-scaffolding', 'design-research'] : ['needs-scaffolding'], source: { kind: 'gemini-notes', url: $json.docUrl, meetingDocId: $json.docUrl?.split('/document/d/')[1]?.split('/')[0] || null }, rawConversation: [{ sender: 'Gemini meeting notes', text: $json.item.rawText }], contextEvidence: [{ claim: $json.item.reason, source: $json.docUrl }], idempotencyKey: `gemini:${$json.docUrl}:${$json.item.itemId}`, autoApprove: false } }}

nodes.name: Create Selected Draft
nodes.notes: No n8n Variables required. Replace the Authorization token or bind a credential before enabling issue creation.

parameters.responseBody: ={{ $json.response || { text: "Selected meeting items were sent to the shared issue service for draft scaffolding." } }}

main.node: Apply Meeting Identity and Idempotency Gate
